curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with the thirty-day titling window for buyers and new residents alike, the penalty fee for missing it, then the title fee beside the larger processing fee, the sales taxes due, the receipt and mailed title, and why the title stays out of the vehicle.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per titling rule; contrast cards for buyer versus new resident on the same window and the title fee versus the processing fee.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a buyer or newcomer and asking about the deadline, the fees or what happens to the title.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show that title requirements change with new or used and in-state or out-of-state, then walk through the new Missouri vehicle: the dealer's title application and assigned MSO, what the MSO proves, and the odometer disclosure on its back.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per MSO rule; contrast cards for the odometer on the MSO versus on a title.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a new-car purchase from a Missouri dealer and asking which document or step applies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Move to the used Missouri vehicle and its properly assigned title, contrast it with the MSO for new vehicles, list what a properly assigned title shows, then the model-year rule for odometer disclosure and how buyer and seller confirm the mileage.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each used-vehicle and odometer rule; contrast cards for the MSO versus the assigned title and the title disclosure versus the seller's mileage entry.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a used-car sale and asking what the title or odometer disclosure must include.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the papers for a new or used vehicle bought outside Missouri, the dealer's reassigned title, the bill of sale and last registration when the other state has no title, the ID or OD verification form, and the separate salvage rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per out-of-state rule; contrast cards for the seller's assigned title versus the dealer's reassigned title and who completes the ID or OD form.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a vehicle bought in another state and asking which documents the buyer needs.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain who must register in Missouri and the new resident's own thirty-day registration deadline, turning in the out-of-state title and the lender exception, then plates and tabs, how fees are set, the two-year parity rule with its example, and specialty plates.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each registration rule; contrast cards for the registration deadline versus the title deadline and one-year versus two-year registration.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a new resident or a model year and asking what registration requires or allows.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with the renewal notice and the duty to renew even without it, keeping your address current and how to report a change, then the renewal papers, tax receipts after one-year and two-year registrations, insurance, the inspection certificate window, and online renewal with a PIN.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per renewal rule; contrast cards for the two-month notice versus the sixty-day inspection window and one-year versus two-year tax receipts.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing an owner preparing to renew and asking what to bring or when.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Finish with the Notice of Sale a seller files within thirty days and where to turn it in, the duty to replace lost or destroyed items and their costs, and the stolen plates and tabs replacement with its affidavit and twice-a-year limit.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each selling and replacement rule; contrast cards for stolen versus lost or destroyed plates and tabs.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a sale or a missing plate, tab or title and asking what the owner must do or pay.
